references.context: General topology: continuous closed map g:A→B sending every closed subset F⊆A to a closed subset g(F)⊆B. Here g=id_Z×f uses the product topologies, with no implicit Hausdorff or compactness requirement.
references.reason: Closedness of a map is reusable independently of Bourbaki properness, which requires this property for every topological space Z.
references.matching_note: Compare to missing.5afce6513485dfbcf054 and related general closed-map candidates, without treating properness as a synonym.

references.disposition: The quantifier runs over all Z, not just discrete, compact, or base-change-over-Y spaces.
